## Body

PR306 performance receipt 40f84bb133ee0b9622d065be0712b49072eb7290. Trace work before source selection: observe_bind resolves a recognized OMP footer before native_runtime_model, so even native-answered canaries pay one omp.models launch. Rate denominator is qualifying canaries, not live seats. StatusPort shares per-seat cursors and serializes folds, but incremental IO is not a constant CPU/memory/deadline bound: cold/reset reads fold the transcript, warm derivation also visits retained turn accumulators, and the 64MiB record/batch cap is not a total-work cap. Exact-head JUnit proves test execution, not deployed latency.
